   reject timers: no byte > HANG_MS (default 90s) -> abort + retry
   (log 'upstream hang >Xms, retry N/3'), client kept alive by pings;
 - preserved: crash-guard safeEnqueue/closed/cancel, 403/503 retries,
   UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS=900s cap, no body/prompt/key logging.
